{{Otheruses|Defense Force}}
The '''Zelosian Home Defense Force''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] defense force of [[Zelos II]]. [[Galleros Nul]] served in the Zelosian Home Defense Force, rising to the rank of [[General/Legends|general]] before becoming the [[Mandated Commander of the People of Zelos]].
